component.name: Device Dock
component.summary: Manage iPhones, files and local backups

description.p: A native GTK 4 / libadwaita application for managing iPhones, their files and local iTunes/Finder backups on Linux.

ul.li: Live device discovery and identity through usbmuxd and libimobiledevice
Backup creation with byte-accurate progress, cancel and resume
Encrypted-backup unlocking, manifest browsing, search and preview
Parsed views of contacts, messages, call history, notes and calendar
Photos, videos, music, podcast and document browsing with export
Restore a backup to its device, and restore a device to factory settings
HTML inventory reports and integrity verification

description.p: Backups are only read. A device is written to — file transfer, restore or factory reset — only after an explicit confirmation.
Rename the application to Device Dock, with the package and command device-dock and the application ID io.github.bitsbreaches.DeviceDock.

Existing settings, logs, cached data and the backup library are moved from the former directories automatically; no backup is copied or deleted. The package replaces apple-devices and removes its old launcher.
First open-source release: Device Dock is now free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 only (GPL-3.0-only), with the complete source code published.
The proprietary end-user licence agreement, its first-run acceptance dialog and the proprietary ownership notices have been removed.
